content.value: Adapt traversal algorithms to get, set, and size. Common tasks filter elements, compute statistics, detect duplicates, insert in order, and reverse lists. Keep index shifts in mind. A sorted-insertion algorithm advances while current values are smaller, then inserts at the first suitable position.
For sorted values [2, 6, 9] and target 7, i stops at 2 and insertion gives [2, 6, 7, 9]. Short-circuit evaluation protects get(i) when i equals size(). The empty list works: insertion occurs at zero.
Practice: trace the example by hand, change one input, and explain how the result changes. Check an empty or boundary case when the preconditions allow it.
